subject_session: 8 sessions (Achilles, Buddy, Cicero, Gatsby); e.g. Achilles-10252013

headline_stat.name: fraction of POST-sleep ripples with significant rank-order replay (per session)

verdict: The run found the right dataset and built a sound, reproducible pipeline that clearly demonstrates ripples, but it was truncated before any write-up, the replay half of the task comes back at chance and is undemonstrated, so the deliverable is incomplete and its conclusion unsupported.

justification.dataset: 000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1) is the canonical dataset for both ripples and replay, an expert-standard choice.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI with correct epoch extraction, ripple-power channel selection, and linearized-position place fields on excitatory units, though quality filtering is light and an unsorted-timestamps warning is left uninvestigated.
justification.analysis: Ripple detection and rank-order replay testing with a proper per-event shuffle null are appropriate, but the first-spike rank method is underpowered and no population-level significance test against chance is done.
justification.correctness: Reported per-session fractions reproduce from the committed code, are internally consistent, and are physically possible, though the run never computed a final pooled statistic.
justification.figures: The example ripple and place-field figures clearly show ripples and a clean spatial template with labeled units, but there is no figure for the replay result and the plots are scratch/validation rather than a finalized suite.
justification.honesty: No write-up exists, so nothing is overstated or fabricated, but there is also no stated result, calibration, or limitation to assess.
